loadErrorBody: This could not be loaded. Nothing was changed. Try again.
errorBody: Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
invalidBody: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
conflictBody: Reload to see the latest version, then make your change again.
auditFailed: Saved, but the audit entry could not be written. Tell an administrator.
readOnlyReason: You do not have permission to change this record.
deniedActionBody: This needs permission on these records. Ask an owner to change your role or add the permission.
deniedSupport: Support sessions cannot change saved views.
recordsDeniedBody: Viewing them needs the read permission for this record type. Ask an owner to change your role or add the permission.
recordsErrorBody: The records could not be loaded. Nothing was changed. Try again.
emptyBody: Add the first {noun} to start the list.
noMatchBody: Clear a filter or search for something else.
truncated: Showing the latest {n}. Narrow the filters to see others.
demoList: Demo workspace: this example record type and its records are not saved.
saveViewBody: Saves the current filters, sort and columns.
viewShareDenied: Sharing views needs the share permission. You can keep this view private.
viewNameInvalid: Give the view a name of 1 to 80 characters.
recordGoneBody: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list to pick another.
titleMasked: This name is hidden from you, so it cannot be changed here.
deleteRecordBody: It disappears from lists and searches. Ask an administrator if it needs to be restored.
deleteDenied: Deleting needs the delete permission for this record type.
relatedEmpty: Nothing is linked to this record yet.
relatedError: The related records could not be loaded. Try again.
linkRecordBody: Search for a record to link to this one.
linkSelf: A record cannot be linked to itself.
linkTargetDenied: You cannot read that record type, so it cannot be linked.
objectsPageSub: Create your own record types, with their own fields, layouts and permissions. Disabling a type hides it; its records are kept.
objectsEmptyBody: Create one for anything you track that is not a lead, deal, account or task.
demoObjects: Demo workspace: the example object shown here is not saved and changes are not stored.
createBody: Give it a name in English (and Tamil if you like), an icon and the name of its main field.
editBody: The key and the main field cannot be changed after creation.
helpPrimary: The field that names each record, for example Name or Title.
keyPreview: Key: {key}. It is used in links and permissions and cannot be changed later.
keyTaken: An object with the key "{key}" already exists.
policyOff: Custom objects are switched off for your organisation.
primaryFieldFailed: The object was created, but its main field "{key}" could not be added. Add it in Custom fields.
objDeniedBody: Managing custom objects needs the objects.manage permission. Ask an owner to change your role or add the permission.
objDeniedSupport: Support sessions cannot change custom objects.
permissionsNote: Each object gets read, write and delete permissions that you can give to roles.
layoutsPageSub: Choose what a record page and its list show, and in which order. A layout can apply to everyone or to one role.
layoutsNoObjectsTitle: No custom objects to lay out
layoutsNoObjectsBody: Create a custom object first. Layouts for lead, deal, account and contact pages are part of the record page work.
layoutsDeniedBody: Managing layouts needs the layouts.manage permission. Ask an owner to change your role or add the permission.
layoutScopeHelp: A workspace layout wins over an organisation-wide one.
layoutRoleHelp: A role layout wins over one for everyone.
resolved_workspace_role: a layout for this workspace and role
resolved_org_role: an organisation-wide layout for this role
layoutHasOverride: This layout is saved for exactly this choice.
layoutInherited: Nothing is saved for this choice yet. It currently uses {scope}; saving creates a separate layout.
layoutIsDefault: Nothing is saved for this choice yet. It uses the generated default; saving creates a layout.
demoLayouts: Demo workspace: changes are checked but not saved.
sectionEmpty: No fields in this section yet.
unplacedNote: {n} field(s) are not on this layout and will not be shown: {fields}.
layoutReset: Layout removed. The next broader layout applies.
